summary.plain: The High Resolution Spectrometer, a detector at the PEP ring at SLAC that recorded electron-positron collisions at 29 GeV.
summary.technical: HRS detector at PEP (29 GeV e⁺e⁻); the 1990 four-lepton QED paper used 291 pb⁻¹. Subsystems were not recorded.
